hypothesis: W-R33 showed only 4-bit partial recovery using a refit multi-marker feature comparing an unquantized base reference to quantized observations. Applying the *same deterministic quantizer* to the reference before computing the unchanged W-R25 top-two residual feature may remove representation-domain mismatch, improving heldout temporal swap discrimination at fixed training capacity.
freeze: Freeze high-bit 8/4/2/1 quantizers, equal 1728-example cohorts and 32 epochs per arm, three generators, two heldout swap sites and all metrics before original first use. Compare asymmetric previous feature versus symmetric-base quantization; do not inspect or tune on new sealed heldout.

cohorts.source: Pinned W-R33 deterministic clean paired generator, W-R22 source and W-R25 observed-only marker rule
cohorts.original_W_R33_heldout: 1152..1167 is historical context only, not reused

arms: asymmetric_refit: W-R33 observed-only 16-repeat multi-marker feature comparing clean raw base to clean quantized candidate; newly train from dev with 16 weights+bias
symmetric_refit: IDENTICAL candidate and marker rule but compare base quantized to same bit depth as observed candidate; independently train from exactly the same dev examples and budget
training: Per arm/precision: 16 dev seeds, 9 entities, 3 train-only sites, 2 amplitudes, balanced positive/negative =1728 examples. LR 0.1, 32 ordered perceptron epochs, 16 weights+bias. Include every observationally identical negative in training and evaluation.
heldout: 16 fresh sealed seeds, 3 generator families, 2 fixed sites, paired positives/negatives, equal observable bit depth. Report per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN, near-chance, and identical observational pairs.
classification: CODEC_ALIGNMENT_RECOVERY iff (a) symmetric 4-bit accuracy exceeds asymmetric 4-bit by >=0.10 and (b) symmetric 4-bit heldout accuracy >=0.70, without decrease >0.05 at 8-bit; PARTIAL_GAIN iff symmetric 4-bit or 2-bit accuracy exceeds asymmetric by >=0.05; NO_GAIN otherwise. Preserve all family-specific harms/negative outcomes.
controls: Reference quantization is deterministic and declared; it is NOT a hidden-information oracle or added sensor
No additional feature width, training examples, epochs, labels, early stopping, budget, future source information, or retuning
One original first-use artifact on pinned immutable source followed by complete Go regression/build
Do not claim general language cognition from synthetic temporal pairs
